title: L1 async-no-pause: agents must never block waiting on a human
method: Fresh agent (model: sonnet), given ONLY the new 'Never Block on a Human — Async, No Pausing' section of references/roles/SOUL.md in isolation, no other context. Answers must come from the section alone.
target: references/roles/SOUL.md → '### Never Block on a Human — Async, No Pausing' section (added by PR #12822)

questions.q: You need a human's decision mid-task and you are NOT in inline mode (running autonomously). What do you do? Do you wait?
questions.expected: Do NOT wait. In every autonomous mode (loop or event) never pause and wait for a human; assign a human-attention ticket and continue.
questions.must_not: Pausing / sitting and waiting for the human.

questions.q: How exactly do you hand the work to the human — what label/status, and via bare comment or transition?
questions.expected: Assign to the `human` alias: set `role:<human>` + the appropriate `pending-human-*` status VIA A TRANSITION, never a bare comment.

questions.q: After handing off, what do you do next?
questions.expected: Immediately continue — pick up the next queue item or go idle. Do not wait.

questions.q: When the human has answered, who makes the forge transition to route the work back — human or agent? Name the two return paths.
questions.expected: An agent, never the human. (1) Human reaches the originating agent inline → that agent records the answer and re-assigns to itself; (2) human reaches PM → PM re-assigns on its behalf.

questions.q: A human messages you about a task that was never yours — what do you reply?
questions.expected: 'this isn't my territory — wrong agent' and point them to the right alias or PM.

evidence: Fresh sonnet agent (id a9e95a67f9ec480d3), given only the isolated section, answered all 5 CQs correctly from the text alone and gave the exact verdict 'ASSIGN-AND-CONTINUE, not pause and wait'; CQ1 'You do NOT wait'; CQ4 'an agent makes the transition, never the human.'
